operators.name: norm_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.layout: contiguous or strides as input; kernel handles general strides

semantics: Corresponds to reference statement: return self.norm(x) where self.norm is BatchNorm2d in eval mode (training=False).
For each channel c, compute y = (x - running_mean[c]) / sqrt(running_var[c] + eps) * weight[c] + bias[c].
Weight and bias may be None (if affine=False); in that case skip affine transformation, using 1 and 0 respectively.
Running_mean and running_var are used as given; no update occurs.
The operation is applied elementwise per channel; broadcasting follows [C] over [N, C, H, W].
Input x must be a CUDA float32 tensor with shape (N, C, H, W); output has same shape, dtype, device.
The operator handles arbitrary strides for x; other tensors are expected contiguous, but binding may ensure .contiguous().
Epsilon is a positive float added to variance before reciprocal square root.
Applies BatchNorm2d evaluation mode using running_mean and running_var, with affine parameters weight and bias.
Output tensor has same shape [32,3,256,512], dtype float32, device cuda.
No training updates; no gradient tracking in forward.
